column1: # the cases of the image lane, one row per case and host, tab separated. a case's
# inputs are the files of test/image/<case>/: each .c, .s and .S is compiled by
# clang for the host's triple with cflags, and each .o and .obj is taken as it is.
# mink links them with the host's link options and the row's link options. the
# image must exit with exit and print exactly test/image/<case>/stdout, or nothing
# when the case has no such file. "-" stands for an empty cflags or link.
